messages:
Lee: Heads up — noticed a new failure mode on the int4 canary where the toolcall response sometimes comes back wrapped in a single-element array. Example:

Lee:
```json
[{"action":"call","name":"lookup","arguments":{"id":123}}]
```

Lee: Expected:
```json
{"action":"call","name":"lookup","arguments":{"id":123}}
```

Maria: Hmm, saw something like that last week on a different model. could be streaming boundary or a serializer that always emits arrays for lists. :thinking_face:

Simon: Can you paste the canary request id / model + quant tag?

Lee: trace id 2026-03-21T12:02:03Z id=canary-68432. model=raven-lite-int4-v2 quant=int4 kernel=fast-kv

Lee: Also seeing parse failure spikes in the slice where canary runs: parse_fail_rate=1.75% -> sample below shows the array wrap causing our strict funcall parser to reject

canary-bot: Canary report: structured-output-parse-failures=1.82% (window=30m) — alerted by threshold

Maria: We already have ndjson unwrap fallback, but it doesn't handle single-element arrays. risk if we automatically unwrap arrays: might hide legitimate multi-action responses.

Simon: Proposal: apply unwrap-if-single-element AND contains keys 'action'|'name' as a safe heuristic. Add metric tag `parse_unwrap=true` so we can rollback if needed.

Lee: +1. also add unit tests covering arrays of length >1 to ensure we don't change behaviour.

Maria: Also run the canary eval harness (1000 prompts) with patch to ensure no regression on multi-action ground truth.

Simon: I'll grep logs for the pattern `\"[\{\\\"action\\\"` across canaries to estimate frequency. cc @Lee

Lee: grep results: 89 hits across last 24h, mostly from int4 canaries, a few from streaming dev mirrors.

canary-bot: Deploy scheduled: unpack-array-fallback v1 -> staging at 6843220200

Simon: Deployed patch to staging, running canary harness now. Perf impact negligible. :thumbsup:

canary-bot: Staging canary results after patch: structured-output-parse-failures=0.42% (window=30m)

Lee: Nice. Create follow-up ticket INFER-7421 for permanent fix + telemetry. https://redwood-internal/issue/INFER-7421

Maria: Agreed. I'll own the eval run and add regression alerts. Thanks team. :raised_hands:

Simon: leaving a small note in release notes about heuristic and opt-out via config parse.unwrap_single_array=false

Lee: merging to main after one more review. thanks all.
